result.instructions: Tools for WeFile, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List my companies on WeFile and when each accounting period ends."; "Create a draft CT600 filing for company 2 for the year to 31 December 2025."; "Save the profit and loss figures for filing 123, then show me the computed tax.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes WeFile data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run wefile_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run wefile_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run wefile_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. wefile_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: wefile_list_companies
tools.title: List companies
tools.description: List the companies in your WeFile workspace, with their WeFile company id, name, Companies House number and filing count. Start here to find the companyId for other tools. WeFile API: GET /companies.

search.description: Search by company name or number.

tools.name: wefile_get_company_periods
tools.title: Get accounting periods
tools.description: Get the accounting reference date and the accounting periods of one company, with the filed flags and due dates from HMRC and Companies House. Uses Companies House data. WeFile API: GET /company/periods.

companyId.description: WeFile internal company id (from wefile_list_companies), not the Companies House number.

tools.name: wefile_add_company
tools.title: Add company
tools.description: Add a UK company to your WeFile workspace by its 8-character Companies House number. WeFile fills in the name and address from Companies House. WeFile API: POST /company/add.

companyNumber.description: The 8-character Companies House company number, for example 12345678.

tools.name: wefile_list_filings
tools.title: List filings
tools.description: List the filings in your WeFile workspace: CT600 returns and Companies House accounts, with their status. WeFile API: GET /filings.

status.description: Filter by filing status, for example draft, in_progress, submitted, completed, requires_attention.

tools.name: wefile_get_filing_status
tools.title: Get filing status
tools.description: Get the overall status of a filing and its submission history. WeFile polls HMRC and Companies House first, so the result shows the latest accept or reject. Use it after wefile_submit_filing. WeFile API: GET /filing/status.

filingId.description: WeFile filing id (from wefile_create_filing or wefile_list_filings).

tools.name: wefile_list_submissions
tools.title: List submissions
tools.description: List the submissions made for a filing to HMRC and Companies House, with their status, HMRC IRmark and body hash. Does not poll the agencies; use wefile_get_filing_status for that. WeFile API: GET /filing/submissions.

filingId.description: WeFile filing id (from wefile_create_filing or wefile_list_filings).

tools.name: wefile_list_documents
tools.title: List documents
tools.description: List the documents WeFile can generate for a filing (accounts, tax computation, CT600), with whether each is available now. WeFile stores no documents; generate them with wefile_generate_document. WeFile API: GET /filing/document/list.

filingId.description: WeFile filing id (from wefile_create_filing or wefile_list_filings).

tools.name: wefile_generate_document
tools.title: Generate document
tools.description: Generate one filing document from the saved filing data. PDFs come back as base64 text and iXBRL as HTML. Results over 200,000 characters are cut and marked truncated. Filings over 12 months need subPeriod 1 or 2. WeFile API: GET /filing/document/generate.

filingId.description: WeFile filing id (from wefile_create_filing or wefile_list_filings).

type.description: Document type, as listed by wefile_list_documents.

subPeriod.description: Sub-period 1 or 2 for a filing over 12 months. Omit for a normal filing.

tools.name: wefile_create_filing
tools.title: Create filing
tools.description: Create a draft CT600 and Companies House filing for one company and accounting period. Nothing is sent to HMRC or Companies House yet. For an amendment of a WeFile filing, set isAmendment and amendmentOfFilingId. For an amendment of a return filed elsewhere, set isAmendment only: the draft starts empty. WeFile API: POST /filing/create.

companyId.description: WeFile internal company id (from wefile_list_companies), not the Companies House number.

isDormant.description: true for a dormant company (no trading figures).

charityStatus.description: Set for a charity or CASC filing only.

directorName.description: Full name of the signing director.

associatedCompanies.description: Number of associated companies in the period. Changes the marginal relief limits.

includePnlInAccounts.description: Include the profit and loss account in the Companies House accounts.

amendmentOfFilingId.description: The WeFile filing id to amend. Leave out for an amendment of a return filed elsewhere.

tools.name: wefile_save_filing
tools.title: Save filing
tools.description: Save the figures and settings of a draft filing. Set profitLossData and balanceSheetData from the figures the user gives; WeFile computes the totals and the tax. Status in_progress starts the payment step. Send the gateway password and the Companies House code only to wefile_submit_filing. Required: filingTypes, before submit. WeFile API: POST /filing/save.

filingId.description: WeFile filing id (from wefile_create_filing or wefile_list_filings).

status.description: Target status, for example in_progress. in_progress starts the payment step.

accountType.description: micro = FRS 105 micro-entity; full = FRS 102 small company.

isDormant.description: Mark the filing as dormant. Forces employees and associated companies to 0.

isCloseCompany.description: false means no CT600A is filed.

filingTypes.description: Which submissions to make, for example { "ct600": true, "accounts": true }.

profitLossData.description: Profit and loss figures in whole pounds: turnover, costOfRawMaterials, staffCosts, depreciation, otherCharges, interestPayable, interestIncome, and others from the API docs.

balanceSheetData.description: Balance sheet figures in whole pounds, from the API docs.

previousProfitLossData.description: Prior period profit and loss, for comparatives.

previousBalanceSheetData.description: Prior period balance sheet, for comparatives.

credentialsData.description: Non-secret fields: utrNumber, directorName, boardApprovalDate (DD/MM/YYYY), filingMode (agent) and agent fields. Do not send gatewayPassword or authCode here.

notesData.description: Custom notes for the financial statements, up to 20.

supplementaryPagesData.description: CT600A and CT600E schedules, from the API docs.

tools.name: wefile_delete_filing_credentials
tools.title: Delete stored credentials
tools.description: Remove the stored HMRC gateway id, gateway password and Companies House code from a filing. Other fields stay. Refused while a submission is in flight. WeFile API: POST /filing/credentials/delete.

filingId.description: WeFile filing id (from wefile_create_filing or wefile_list_filings).

tools.name: wefile_submit_filing
tools.title: Submit filing
tools.description: Send a filing to HMRC, Companies House or both. A live key (wf_live_) files a real return, so confirm the figures first; try a test key (wf_test_) before a live one. Pass the gateway credentials here for this call only: WeFile uses them once and does not store them. Check the result with wefile_get_filing_status. WeFile API: POST /filing/submit.

filingId.description: WeFile filing id (from wefile_create_filing or wefile_list_filings).

target.description: "hmrc" for CT600, "ch" for Companies House, "both" for both.

credentials.description: One-time credentials for this submission only.

gatewayPassword.description: HMRC Government Gateway password. Used once, not stored.

authCode.description: Companies House authentication code. Used once, not stored.

utrNumber.description: Unique Taxpayer Reference of the company.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with WeFile
prompts.description: What you can do with WeFile here, with example requests to try.
